VERDICT: LGTM

The new `getMembershipTier()` sits exactly where it belongs: alongside the existing family of derived `@Transient` getters (`getDisplayName`, `getInitials`, `getMembershipNumber`) in `Owner.java`. It mirrors their conventions precisely — same `@Transient` annotation, same Javadoc shape (summary plus a "Not persisted — derived from…" line linking the source getters), and the same style of deriving a single string from existing fields. The two-boolean decomposition (`uniqueName`, `hasEmail`) reads cleanly and keeps the logic in the right unit (the entity that owns the source fields), with no duplication and nothing turning into a catch-all.

The OpenAPI addition follows the surrounding pattern for derived fields (`type: string`, `readOnly: true`, title/description/example), and its placement next to the other owner properties is natural. A maintainer of this codebase would find both changes idiomatic.
